Source for the GETSU RAIDER app folder (title PPSA99606). THIRD_PARTY.md says
what each part is and its licence.

GETSU RAIDER modifications (our changes; full corresponding source in the
future companion archive GETSU-RAIDER-PPSA99606-source, see BUILDING-GETSU-RAIDER.md):
  - the GETSU front-end in eboot.bin  native/getsu_landing.{c,h},
    native/pw_getsu_front.{c,h}, wired into native/wine64_main.c
    (also: the app0 sandbox is looked up at run time, resolve_sandbox_app0,
    instead of the fixed <title>_000, so a reinstalled tile still finds its runtime)
  - win/wine/lib/wine/x86_64-unix/ntdll.prx  our lazy-commit + page-file build
    SHA-256 5af1a1d52937e52984acb59ce5dcf6a0696f0829d241915704ae64646241cade
    (source: wine/ps5/pw_wine_dmem*.c and the Wine patches 0986, 0995, 0996
    and 0997 in wine/patches/ of the companion)
  - win/wine/lib/wine/x86_64-unix/libvulkan.prx  RADV + budget-headroom patch
    SHA-256 72e1ba85ca03c07bb32cf2dfd62eee83db1e611e699265b233ead62f675830f1
    (source: patches/radv/0001-radv-ps5-budget-headroom.patch in the companion)

The upstream parts the modifications build on:

prospero-win  https://github.com/mpereiraesaa/prospero-win  commit 404cac6ebbb236d2486d2796fd28b9bd39f2caa6
Wine  https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/wine  commit 490f6d5dcbb2a5047345b8af88d114bbcaad69a8,
  with the 104 patches in the companion's wine/patches: prospero-win's 100
  plus our 4 (0986 host-page, 0995 lazy commit, 0996 futex queue lock,
  0997 prefault kernel read buffers)
PS5 Native App Boilerplate  https://github.com/mpereiraesaa/ps5-native-app-boilerplate
  title: commit 9c0b994a048521af6fb84c73ded364504fe250e9
  PS5 module tools: commit 30597512539e7edfde079cbcaf4a626bc0a948c5
PS5 payload SDK  https://github.com/ps5-payload-dev/sdk  the release the boilerplate pins
FreeType 2.13.3  https://download.savannah.gnu.org/releases/freetype/freetype-2.13.3.tar.xz
  SHA-256 0550350666d427c74daeb85d5ac7bb353acba5f76956395995311a9c6f063289

  built locally for title PPSA99606 with its tools/build_owned_daemon.py
